sections.content: Combine a furniture noun with van and a location word to say where something is: the furniture noun (with its article) comes first, then the location word, then van at the end.

items.spanish: Az asztal a kanapé előtt van.
items.english: The table is in front of the sofa.

items.spanish: A szék az asztal mellett van.
items.english: The chair is next to the table.

sections.content: Notice előtt and mellett both come right before van, not right after the noun they describe — Hungarian location phrases end in van, they don't open with it.
